title: A routine brief carries only what its prompt asked for
replays: The 28 Oct class: the commute brief arrived late and carried food and quiz text the routine prompt never asked for. The guard on extra content in routine replies is still open.

steps.name: morning-brief
steps.task: The daily commute brief: disruptions on the district line this morning.
steps.reply: Commute: the district line has severe delays this morning between 07:00 and 09:00 due to signal work at the central depot. Also, a fun fact for you: did you know the blue whale is the largest animal ever known? And a quick food fact: a blueberry muffin has about 360 kcal.
